entities.name: Franciszek Duszeńko
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Franciszek Duszeńko was a Polish sculptor, professor of the Academy of Fine Arts in Gdańsk and its Rector in the years 1981–87. He was a former prisoner of Nazi concentration camps in World War II.
